exams.name: Uniform Certified Public Accountant Examination
exams.notes: Board may prescribe form and manner; may be conducted by board or by public or private organization; candidate who fails has right to reexamination.
exams.quote: An applicant for a certified public accountant license shall have successfully passed an examination in subjects the board deems appropriate, and in the form and manner that the board deems appropriate.

interval_years.quote: A permit issued under this chapter to a certified public accountant or a public accountant expires at 12 midnight on the last day of the month of the legal birthday of the licensee during the second year of a two-year term if not renewed.

required.quote: The Legislature has determined it is in the public interest to require that certified public accountants and public accountants licensed under provisions of this chapter comply with continuing education requirements adopted by the board as a prerequisite to the renewal of public accountancy licenses

period_years.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period.

value: 24 hours governmental accounting and auditing (for licensees who plan, direct, or approve financial or compliance audit reports on governmental agencies)
24 hours accounting and auditing related to reporting on financial statements (for licensees who provide audit, review, other attestation services, or issue compiled financial statement reports)
course on provisions of this chapter and rules of professional conduct (within a six-year period)
topical_requirements.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period. (c) A licensee who provides audit, review, other attestation services, or issues compiled financial statement reports shall, during the two-year license renewal period, complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of accounting and auditing related to reporting on financial statements. (d) A licensee with a valid permit to practice public accountancy shall, within a six-year period, complete a continuing education course on the provisions of this chapter and the rules of professional conduct.

available.quote: The board may issue a certified public accountant license to any applicant who is a holder of a current, active, and unrestricted certified public accountant license issued under the laws of any state with comparable licensure requirements

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current, active, and unrestricted CPA license from another state with comparable licensure requirements (i.e., passage of the CPA exam and education/experience meeting or exceeding California's standards) and must not have committed acts constituting grounds for denial. To sign attest reports, must also meet Section 5095 experience requirements.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a certified public accountant license to any applicant who is a holder of a current, active, and unrestricted certified public accountant license issued under the laws of any state with comparable licensure requirements and who has not committed acts or crimes constituting grounds for denial under Section 480.

exists.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs the California Board of Accountancy, which consists of 15 members, 7 of whom shall be licensees, and 8 of whom shall be public members

national_certification.quote: The International Qualifications Appraisal Board jointly established by the National Association of State Boards of Accountancy and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants has determined that the standards under which the applicant was licensed or under which the applicant secured comparable authority meet its standards for admission to the International Uniform Certified Public Accountant Qualification Examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a CPA or public accountant.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a certified public accountant or a public accountant.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of sections dealing with false statements or omissions in the application for a license, certificate, or permit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of Section 478, 498, or 499 dealing with false statements or omissions in the application for a license, in obtaining a certificate as a certified public accountant, in obtaining registration under this chapter, or in obtaining a permit to practice public accountancy under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated negligent acts in engagements indicating a lack of competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, gross negligence, or repeated negligent acts committed in the same or different engagements, for the same or different clients, or any combination of engagements or clients, each resulting in a violation of applicable professional standards that indicate a lack of competency in the practice of public accountancy

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, or suspension of a certificate or other authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any other state or foreign country.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, or suspension of a certificate or other authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant, refusal to renew the certificate or other authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant, or any other discipline by any other state or foreign country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the audit documentation requirements of Section 5097.
Willful violation of the accountancy chapter or any board rule or regulation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of this chapter or any rule or regulation promulgated by the board under the authority granted under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any governmental body or agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any governmental body or agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fiscal dishonesty or breach of fiduciary responsibility of any kind.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fiscal dishonesty or breach of fiduciary responsibility of any kind.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowing preparation, publication, or dissemination of false, fraudulent, or materially misleading financial statements, reports, or information.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money or property by fraudulent means.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money, property, or other valuable consideration by fraudulent means or false pretenses.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Imposition of discipline, penalty, or sanction by the PCAOB or SEC under Sarbanes-Oxley or other federal legislation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The imposition of any discipline, penalty, or sanction on a registered public accounting firm or any associated person of such firm, or both, or on any other holder of a permit, certificate, license, or other authority to practice in this state, by the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board or the United States Securities and Exchange Commission, or their designees under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 or other federal legislation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawfully engaging in the practice of public accountancy in another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawfully engaging in the practice of public accountancy in another state.

insurance_required.quote: an accountancy corporation as a condition of obtaining a certificate pursuant to the Moscone-Knox Professional Corporation Act and this article shall provide adequate security by insurance or otherwise for claims against it by its clients arising out of the rendering of professional services.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Permits to engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state shall be issued by the board only to holders of the certificate of certified public accountant issued under this chapter and to those partnerships, corporations, and other persons who, upon application approved by the board, are registered with the board under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: a person shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of public accountancy within the meaning and intent of this chapter if they do any of the following: (a) Hold themselves out to the public in any manner as one skilled in the knowledge, science, and practice of accounting...(c) Offer to prospective clients to perform for compensation, or does perform on behalf of clients for compensation, professional services that involve or require an audit, examination, verification, investigation, certification, presentation, or review of financial transactions and accounting records...
definition_quote.quote: a person shall be deemed to be engaged in the practice of public accountancy within the meaning and intent of this chapter if they do any of the following: (a) Hold themselves out to the public in any manner as one skilled in the knowledge, science, and practice of accounting, and as qualified and ready to render professional service as a public accountant for compensation.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section may engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state, and a notice, fee, or other requirement shall not be imposed on that individual by the board.

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: Licensees shall in the aggregate, directly or beneficially, hold more than half of the equity capital and possess majority voting rights.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: any firm lawfully engaged in the practice of public accountancy in this state may have owners who are not licensed as certified public accountants or public accountants if the following conditions are met

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: In order to renew its registration in an active status or convert to an active status, a firm, as defined in Section 5035.1, shall have a peer review report of its accounting and auditing practice accepted by a board-recognized peer review program no less frequently than every three years.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: shall have a peer review report of its accounting and auditing practice accepted by a board-recognized peer review program no less frequently than every three years.

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: Nothing in this section affects the discovery or admissibility of evidence in a civil or criminal action.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The holder of an inactive license issued by the board pursuant to Section 462, when lawfully using the title 'certified public accountant,' the CPA designation

retired_license_status_available.quote: The board may establish, by regulation, a system for the placement of a license into a retired status, upon application, for certified public accountants and public accountants who are not actively engaged in the practice of public accountancy

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A certified public accounting firm that is authorized to practice in another state and that does not have an office in this state may engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state through the holder of a practice privilege

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: In each office of a certified public accountant or public accountant in this state which is not under the personal management of such an accountant, respectively, work shall be supervised by a certified public accountant or public accountant.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: To be authorized to sign reports on attest engagements, a licensee shall complete a minimum of 500 hours of experience, satisfactory to the board, in attest services.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: No confidential information obtained by a licensee, in their professional capacity, concerning a client or a prospective client shall be disclosed by the licensee without the written permission of the client or prospective client

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy...shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A person engaged in the practice of public accountancy is prohibited from performing services for a client...for a commission or from receiving a commission from a third party for providing the products or services of that third party to a client...during the period in which the person also performs for that client...any of the services listed below: (1) An audit or review of a financial statement. (2) A compilation of a financial statement....(3) An examination of prospective financial information.

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A person engaged in the practice of public accountancy is prohibited from performing services for a client...for a commission or from receiving a commission from a third party...during the period in which the person also performs for that client...any of the services listed below: (1) An audit or review of a financial statement.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall prohibit a person who holds a valid and current license, registration, certificate, permit, or other authority to practice public accountancy from a foreign country, and lawfully practicing therein, from temporarily engaging in the practice of public accountancy in this state incident to an engagement in that country

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any prosecution or hearing under this chapter, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter shall be sufficient to justify a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm that provides the services described in subdivision (c) of Section 5096 shall obtain a registration from the board.

registered_municipal_accountant_designat.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state unless the person is the holder of a valid permit to practice public accountancy issued by the board or a holder of a practice privilege pursuant to Article 5.1 (commencing with Section 5096)

public_school_accountant_designation.quote: no person shall engage in the practice of public accountancy in this state unless the person is the holder of a valid permit to practice public accountancy issued by the board or a holder of a practice privilege pursuant to Article 5.1 (commencing with Section 5096)

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means any person who has registered with the board as a public accountant and who holds a valid permit for the practice of public accountancy.

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: The holder of a retired license issued by the board pursuant to Section 5070.1, when lawfully using the title 'certified public accountant,' the CPA designation, or any other reference that would suggest that the person is licensed by the board on materials such as correspondence, internet websites, business cards, nameplates, or name plaques, shall place the term 'retired' immediately after that title, designation, or reference.

government_audit_cpe_requirement.quote: A licensee who plans, directs, or approves any financial or compliance audit report on any governmental agency shall complete a minimum of 24 hours of qualifying continuing education in the area of governmental accounting and auditing or related subjects during the two-year license renewal period.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to their client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (1) A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that those working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client. (2) Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client that the licensee removed from the client's premises or received for the client's account.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of this state.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Consent to disciplinary authority of the board
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of this state.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Agreement to comply with the state's public accountancy statutes and board rules
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall comply with the provisions of this chapter, board regulations, and other laws, regulations, and professional standards applicable to the practice of public accountancy by the licensees of this state

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Cessation of practice if home-state license is no longer valid
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall cease exercising the practice privilege in this state if a regulatory agency in a state in which the individual holds a certificate, license, or permit takes disciplinary action resulting in the suspension or revocation, including stayed suspension, stayed revocation, or probation of the individual's certificate, license, or permit

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Appointment of home-state board as agent for service of process
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Is deemed to have appointed the regulatory agency of the state in which the principal place of business identified by the individual is located, as the individual's agent on whom notices, subpoenas, or other process may be served in any action or proceeding by the board against the individual.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Cessation of practice upon conviction of a crime involving dishonesty
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall cease exercising the practice privilege in this state if convicted in any jurisdiction of any crime involving dishonesty, including, but not limited to, embezzlement, theft, misappropriation of funds or property, or obtaining money, property, or other valuable consideration by fraudulent means or false pretenses.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Cessation of practice if barred by the SEC or PCAOB
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if the United States Securities and Exchange Commission or the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board bars the individual from practicing before them.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Cessation of practice if any governmental body suspends the right to practice before it
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall cease exercising the practice privilege if any governmental body or agency suspends the right of the individual to practice before the body or agency.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Reporting pending criminal charges to the board
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Shall report to the board in writing any pending criminal charges, other than for a minor traffic violation, in any jurisdiction within 30 days of the date the individual has knowledge of those charges.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Consent to jurisdiction of host-state courts
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: Is subject to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board and the courts of this state.

scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.item: Firm employing individual with practice privileges also deemed to consent to all conditions
scope__practice_privilege_consent_condit.quote: A firm that engages in practice under this section is deemed to consent to the personal, subject matter, and disciplinary jurisdiction of the board with respect to any practice under this section.
